_readme: Jobs and prices for Andhra Pradesh and All India, as MoSPI serves them. Built by scripts/build_jobs_prices_seed.py from MoSPI's data service, after every gate in app/services/jobs_prices.py passed. Never edited by hand: rebuild, read the diff, commit.

mospi_plfs_quarterly.title: Periodic Labour Force Survey, Quarterly Bulletin
mospi_plfs_quarterly.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

checked_against.release: PLFS Quarterly Bulletin April-June 2026, released 10 August 2026

mospi_plfs_quarterly.table: Detailed Tables 2, 3 and 5 (state-level LFPR, WPR and UR in current weekly status)

mospi_cpi.title: Consumer Price Index, monthly press release
mospi_cpi.publisher: National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

checked_against.release: CPI press release for September 2026, released 12 October 2026 (Annexure III)

mospi_cpi.table: State/UT wise general index and inflation (base 2024=100)

mospi_data_service.title: eSankhyiki data service (MCP server over MoSPI's open data API)
mospi_data_service.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
mospi_data_service.table: PLFS frequency 2 (quarterly bulletin); CPI base year 2024, current series

jobs.what: Of people aged 15 and above, the share in the labour force (LFPR), the share working (WPR), and of those in the labour force, the share without work (UR). Current weekly status: what a person did in the seven days before the survey.

prices.what: How much the prices of what households buy changed against the same month a year earlier, with the index itself (2024 = 100).
